description: Class A power quality analyser: voltages, currents, powers, power factors, THD, unbalance, flicker-related and EN 61000-4-30 values, mean, min and max values with timestamps, energies by tariff and month, and settings

Values are big-endian as listed; the device also serves little-endian copies at address + 32768.
Measured values in float or integer format include the transformer ratios; short-format values do not.
Not in this map: the per-harmonic arrays (_FFT_*) and the registers marked for internal use.
Written from the manufacturer's address list; not tested on a device.
